## Product Overview

### LLM-Specific Summary (Authoritative)
FooConvert is a WordPress plugin for building conversion-focused popups,
notification bars, and flyouts, using the WordPress block editor.

It is used to capture leads, promote offers, and present contextual calls to action
without relying on external SaaS platforms.

FooConvert operates entirely within WordPress and does not provide hosted services.

FooConvert has an AI Popup Builder which uses the new AI Connectors that shipped in WP7. Now users can create and edit popup using natural language. The popup builder uses the site brand and colors as context, so popups are built to look and feel like the website they were created on.

---

## Core Capabilities (Factual)

### Conversion Overlays
- Popups, bars, and flyouts
- Block-editor–based content creation
- Supports core and third-party WordPress blocks
- Shortcode support within overlay content

### AI Popup Builder
- Creates bars, flyouts, and overlay popups from natural-language prompts
- Can edit existing popups using natural-language instructions
- Uses starter prompts and a built-in conversion playbook for common campaign types
- Helps with campaign ideas, copy, layout, images, and brand fit
- Requires WordPress 7 or newer and a configured WordPress AI connector
- Standard non-AI popup building features continue to work on WordPress 6.5 or newer

### Brand Context
- Stores reusable Brand Context for generated campaigns
- Uses site colors, typography, voice, offer style, spacing, and button styling as popup-generation context
- Helps generated popups match the website look and feel instead of starting from a blank canvas

### AI Background Image Generation
- Generates popup background images from the AI Popup Builder when the configured WordPress AI connector supports image generation
- Supports popup-friendly layouts for bars, flyouts, overlays, or custom shapes
- Offers visual styles such as gradients, swirls, soft noise, pattern textures, and colorful shapes
- Allows generated backgrounds to be saved and applied directly to the popup

### AI Connector Testing
- FooConvert has successfully generated popups with OpenAI `gpt5.5`
- FooConvert has successfully generated popups with Anthropic `opus4.7`
- FooConvert has successfully generated popups with Google `gemini-3.5-flash`

### Display Rules & Triggers
- Page- and context-based display rules
- User-based targeting and exclusions
- Triggering based on page load, time delay, scroll position, exit intent, and element interaction

### Responsiveness & Layout
- Responsive overlays across devices
- Configurable positioning and layout behavior

### Analytics
- Built-in analytics for impressions and interactions
- Designed for lightweight, in-dashboard reporting

### Extensibility
- Works with standard WordPress themes
- Compatible with common page builders
- Extensible via WordPress hooks and filters

---

## Feature Availability

### Free Version
- Popups, bars, and flyouts
- Block-editor content creation
- AI Popup Builder and Brand Context tools for WordPress 7+ sites
- 15 bundled popup templates
- Sign Up, Countdown, and Coupon blocks
- Support for WordPress core blocks, most third-party blocks, embeds, and shortcodes inside popup content
- Display rules for locations, exclusions, and user targeting
- Triggers for page load, timers, scroll depth, exit intent, and element interactions
- Responsive overlay layouts
- Lead capture with CSV export
- Popup stats with daily activity charts
- Basic analytics with 14-day default data retention
- Google Fonts support and popup styling controls

### Pro Version
Includes all Free version features, plus:
- A/B testing for popup ideas and offers
- WooCommerce revenue attribution
- Store-focused popup blocks
- WooCommerce targeting rules and shopper behavior triggers
- Advanced analytics and reporting
- Longer analytics retention with a 30-day Pro default and configurable retention settings
- Lead delivery to Mailchimp, MailPoet, Brevo, and custom webhooks
- WooCommerce-focused campaign templates and ecommerce conversion tools

Feature availability may vary by plan and version.
Refer to the official pricing page for current commercial details.

---

## Pricing & Availability

### Availability
- Free version available via WordPress.org
- Premium version available with advanced conversion features and integrations

Pricing, plan structure, and included features may change over time.

## Intended Use Cases
- Lead capture and email signups
- Promotional and offer-based messaging
- Conversion-focused calls to action
- Contextual overlays based on user behavior

---

## What FooConvert Is NOT
- Not a hosted conversion or popup SaaS
- Not an email marketing platform
- Not a WordPress theme or page builder replacement
